items.item: Runs or asks for an automation inventory of the existing flows, triggers, workflow rules and process builders on Opportunity and Account before choosing an approach
items.evidence: Section 2 "Automation inventory (run first, against `uat`)" with queries for flows, Process Builder, Apex triggers and workflow rules on Opportunity and Account. The recommendation is marked provisional pending the results.

items.item: Chooses an after-save record-triggered flow (or Apex), not a before-save flow, because it updates a different record
items.evidence: "One after-save record-triggered flow on Opportunity... Why after-save: the change writes to a different record (Account). A before-save flow can only change `$Record`"

items.item: Limits the entry condition to the change to Closed Won (for example ISCHANGED or "only when a record is updated to meet the condition")
items.evidence: "run 'only when a record is updated to meet the condition requirements' with `IsWon = true`... Closed Won must be newly met, so later edits to a won deal don't re-run the flow."

items.item: Mentions bulk behaviour (many Opportunities saved at once) or recursion and order of execution
items.evidence: "Bulk: ... 200 Opportunities on 50 Accounts means one query and one update"; also "Order of execution" and "Recursion: nothing loops."
